badge: A collaborative platform for roleplaying games
title: Keep the memory of your adventures
pitch: Adventure Keeper brings your group's campaigns, characters, session recaps, notes and shared resources together — in one place, open to the whole table.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.description: Gather your table around a campaign: game system, members, summary and status at a glance.

characters.title: Characters
characters.description: Character and NPC sheets: ability scores, hit points, notes and what stays hidden from the players.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Plan the next sessions and keep every session's recap in one place.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Lore, plot or rules notes, visible to you, to the GM or to the whole campaign.

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: Maps, handouts, links and shared files: your campaign library, open to everyone.

houseRules.title: House rules
houseRules.description: Write down your rule tweaks so everyone plays with the same cards in hand.
